claim: § The inherited grammar: 'time is rendered as space — a wider panel, or more gutter before the next, simply lasts longer', and closure happens in the gutter.

pieces.what: One three-panel strip with draggable panel widths and gutters; the reader times how long each beat feels, McCloud's claim put to a stopwatch.
pieces.walks_up_from: two panels and the gap between them

pieces.section: The live edge — black-and-white, plus one bold color
pieces.what: The color-hold proof: the same page in pure B&W, then with one spot colour, then three.
One strip, six stories: the same panels reordered or re-gapped change what happened.
The balloon taxonomy drawn: whisper, shout, radio, thought, with tail termination at 50–60 %.

note: The page has an active baton and a revision draft in proofs; check before making.
